Cute dungeon fantasy, hand-painted chunky game art, heavy outlines, warm upper-left highlights; same three-quarter top-down frontal camera as reference. 
ONE square transparent PNG, precisely a 4-column by 4-row grid of SIXTEEN equal cells, no gutters or borders. Same character, scale, camera, baseline and center in each cell. Each character fits within central 72% of cell with clear transparent padding; effects fit within 92%.
